When a patient is brought to the hospital by an ambulance, the priority of being seen depends on the severity of their condition rather than the mode of arrival alone. Ambulance arrivals are typically triaged upon arrival, and patients are assessed and seen based on the urgency of their medical needs. This means that even if you arrive by ambulance, you will be assessed and seen in order of priority, not necessarily immediately or with the highest priority just because you came by ambulance.
